summary: Tested the Home redesign, the avatar bubble/first-time AvatarBox flow, Profile without FittingAccuracy, the paywall when blocked, and the _tuck_rule unit checks. Desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844, owner user user_389c87aaadc6. Almost everything passes. One bug: 'Rifai foto' after picking a gallery photo does not reopen the gallery picker.

ui_bugs.issue: After choosing a photo from the gallery, clicking 'Rifai foto' does NOT reopen the file picker (Playwright filechooser timed out). RCA: the hidden <input data-testid='avatar-gallery-input' ref={galleryRef}> is only rendered in the non-pending branch. While pending it is unmounted, so galleryRef.current is null when retake() calls galleryRef.current?.click() right after setPending(null). Fix: render the file input outside the pending/non-pending conditional. The same applies in the fullscreen 'Vuoi cambiare foto?' box. Retake for a camera photo calls openCam and should work, but was not tested (no camera in headless).

issues: free-month-line wraps awkwardly: '(7 giorni rimasti)' breaks onto a 2nd line under uppercase tracking text. Consider putting it on its own line or using smaller tracking on mobile.
The bubble loads the full 3000px decrypted avatar for a 36px circle. Heavy on mobile and the image appears late (the bubble/fullscreen showed an empty box for ~2s). Consider a thumbnail.
Escape key does not close it (only the X button). Minor.
